summary.headline: Spencer's Retail Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 13% YoY to Rs 469 crore; EBITDA doubled to Rs 9.4 crore (2% of sales).
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue grew 13% YoY to Rs 469 crore, with Spencer's format up 18% and Nature's Basket down 13% on a YoY basis (quarterly sales Rs 59 crore). Consolidated EBITDA was Rs 9.4 crore versus Rs 4.7 crore a year ago, but last year's base included about Rs 10 crore of lower non-operating income that management stripped out. Management said the EBITDA improvement is shifting from cost-led to sales-growth-led. Nature's Basket saw a management change about 45 days before the call and a reset plan focused on inventory, assortment and execution.

segments.name: Spencer's (format)
segments.commentary: Revenue up 18% YoY and 8% QoQ, with offline +14% and online +49%. Sales per sq ft Rs 1,850 in Q1 (internal target Rs 2,000 in festive quarter); store EBITDA reportedly 2x year-ago, from ~2.5% toward a 7.5-8% short-term aspiration.

segments.name: Nature's Basket
segments.commentary: Revenue Rs 59 crore, down 13% YoY but up 8% QoQ. Management says the setback was internal (stock availability, long-tail SKUs, online build-out); a reset plan is in place under a new management team about 45 days old.

segments.name: Jiffy (online platform)
segments.commentary: Management cited FY25 scale of about Rs 200 crore; no Q1 figure given. Online growth at Spencer's (+49%) is attributed to the platform.

guidance_outlook: Full-year online business growth to steady at around 25%, with no heavy customer-acquisition spend and unchanged unit economics.
Spencer's offline growth guided at mid to high single digits for the year.
Nature's Basket expected to reach early double-digit growth from Q3 and Q4 FY27 after the reset.
No new Spencer's store additions in FY27 beyond relocations and a few cluster tests; calibrated expansion considered for FY28.
No new Nature's Basket stores; limited capex directed to refurbishing existing stores. Management frames EBITDA breakeven as the ambition, with Q2 as the next update.
capex_capacity: No new stores added in Q1 FY27; productivity gains come from the existing footprint of 89 Spencer's and 31 Nature's Basket stores.
Spencer's sales per sq ft Rs 1,850 in Q1; internal target Rs 2,000 in the festive quarter.
Nature's Basket capex limited to refurbishing ageing stores; a small Spencer's store launched in suburban Kolkata two days before the call.
Nature's Basket online tech stack ready, riding on the Jiffy platform; customer acquisition deferred until inventory is fixed. Update promised in Q2.
Debt refinancing process started, with some expected to close in the current month (August).
demand_pricing: Spencer's YoY growth split about 70% from higher number of bills (NOBs) and 30% from higher average bill value (ABV), which management called underlying volume growth.
Category mix broadly unchanged: staples +100 bps, liquor +100 bps, non-food (apparel, E&E, GM) -100 bps, fresh flat.
Membership: launched July 2025, 125,000+ members (~25% of active monthly customers) contributing ~1/3 of monthly sales; member retention ~2x and monthly spend ~3x non-members, with frequency near 5.
Online ABV above Rs 780; repeat rate ~67%; NPS 85+; in-full rate above 90%; on-time delivery just under 30 minutes.
Management declined to enter quick-commerce marketplaces (Instamart, Blinkit) for Nature's Basket, citing margin sharing and sustainability concerns.

qa_highlights.question: How should investors think about the growth trajectory across Spencer's, Jiffy and Nature's Basket over 2-3 years?
qa_highlights.answer: Management does not give segment targets. Online is guided to ~25% full-year growth, Spencer's offline to mid-to-high single digits, and Nature's Basket to early double digits from Q3-Q4.

qa_highlights.question: What KPIs track the Nature's Basket turnaround?
qa_highlights.answer: Three KPIs: sales per sq ft, rupee gross margin (not percentage), and cost control. Cost cuts are limited in NB's premium format; support overheads were optimised once.

qa_highlights.question: Is there any store expansion plan?
qa_highlights.answer: No new Nature's Basket stores. Spencer's has no additions this fiscal beyond relocations and cluster tests; a calibrated expansion may come in FY28.

qa_highlights.question: Could membership reach 50% of business?
qa_highlights.answer: Management focuses on absolute numbers: target 200,000 members shopping at least 5 times a month, contributing 39-42% of sales.

qa_highlights.question: What drove Spencer's growth, volume or pricing?
qa_highlights.answer: About 70% from more bills and 30% from higher ABV; category mix stable, with member special pricing cited as a driver of basket-wide buying.

qa_highlights.question: Update on quick commerce for Nature's Basket and debt status?
qa_highlights.answer: Quick commerce was not pursued; the tech platform is ready but customer acquisition waits on inventory fixes. Consolidated debt Rs 1,266 crore, with refinancing under way and some expected this month.

risks_watch: Nature's Basket remains loss-making at EBITDA level (negative Rs 2.5 crore) with revenue still down YoY; reset success depends on the new management team.
Q1 EBITDA improvement partly reflects a Rs 10 crore non-operating income gap versus last year; underlying gains need confirmation in Q2.
Debt of Rs 1,266 crore with a large portion due for refinancing this year; closure timing is not yet confirmed.
Spencer's gross margin fell to 18.2% from 19.1% YoY on reported basis; management attributes this to membership accounting.
Online growth relies on order volume with unit economics positive at about Rs 18 per order, and the target is limited customer acquisition spend.
key_quotes: So, by all definitions, it was a very strong quarter 1 for us
We've had a change in management at Nature s Basket about 45 days ago, and we've kind of drawn up a complete reset plan, where fundamentally we're changing nothing.
The process has started and it will kind of in the next -- in this month itself, we will get some.
I would be more focused on what was the year-on-year growth, which was negative.
summary.management_tone: Management sounded confident and upbeat on Spencer's, citing eight consecutive months of growth, improving unit economics and store EBITDA roughly 2x year-ago. They were more cautious on Nature's Basket, calling Q1 a setback from internal execution issues, declining to give a turnaround date beyond Q3-Q4 and deferring customer acquisition until inventory is fixed. They were evasive on debt refinancing, giving only a vague timeline of "this month".

adds.what: Small Spencer's store launched in suburban Kolkata (two days before call)

growth.why: Guidance is for Spencer's online ~25% full-year growth, offline mid-to-high single digits, and Nature's Basket early double-digit growth from Q3/Q4 FY27, backed mainly by demand (70% NOB-led growth), membership and existing stores, with no new store capacity until FY28 and no concrete order or capacity numbers for NBL's recovery.
